mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, summary, last_message_id, version, summary_msg_count, detail_msg_count, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_chat_memory_summary WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_memory_summary (conversation_id, user_id, summary, last_message_id, version, summary_msg_count, detail_msg_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{summary}, #{lastMessageId}, #{version}, #{summaryMsgCount}, #{detailMsgCount}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), summary = VALUES(summary), last_message_id = VALUES(last_message_id), version = VALUES(version), summary_msg_count = VALUES(summary_msg_count), detail_msg_count = VALUES(detail_msg_count), updated_at = NOW()
